name: prometheus-plugin
description: Obsidian Community Plugin for the local Prometheus RAG runtime

scripts.lint: eslint "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" && prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "*.{json,md,css}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" && node scripts/check-manifest-version.mjs && node scripts/check-release-versions.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:domain-coverage && npm run build && node scripts/check-prod-bundle.mjs
